compiled_state.title: [Outbound Bridge]: BRIDGE_USER_MAP missing entry for git author 'Test' -> BRIDGE_ALERT emitted on every SYNC event
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 0c26228c77e3322b10a488eb32ef037ca16a127c

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

Per plugins/dso/scripts/bridge/README.md, BRIDGE_USER_MAP must contain an entry (email -> Jira accountId, case-insensitive) for every git author that produces SYNC events. When complete, outbound runs should not emit BRIDGE_ALERT events for unmapped users.

#### Actual Behavior

Every outbound bridge run since 2026-05-11 emits a BRIDGE_ALERT for each SYNC event with reason: `no BRIDGE_USER_MAP entry for Test`.

Latest run 25771439814 emitted 9 such alerts (one per ticket). Deterministic — fires on every run.

### 3. Action History

Resolution options:
1. Add 'Test' (or its email) to BRIDGE_USER_MAP repo secret.
2. Change git config user.name in the worktree to a mapped identity.

### 6. Logs

```
{"event_type":"BRIDGE_ALERT","reason":"no BRIDGE_USER_MAP entry for Test"}
```
